notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
tcpdump in parallel with an nc banner grab provides packet-level visibility into the TCP exchange. The PSH-ACK packet from the server (step 4 in extended three-way handshake) carries the banner data. Reveals what tools may suppress, normalize, or miss.

=== CHAINING ===
Terminal 1: tcpdump -i eth0 host TARGET → Terminal 2: nc TARGET PORT → observe: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, PSH-ACK (banner) in tcpdump output → banner content visible at packet level.

=== DIAGNOSTIC VALUE ===
tcpdump captures the actual bytes exchanged, not the tool's interpretation of them. Essential when nmap/nc output seems incomplete or when verifying exactly what data a service sends before authentication.
